rules: LLM search engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini) rely on structured markdown comparison tables with explicit headers when answering 'vs' comparison queries.
Video embeds (YouTube, Loom, Vimeo) and heavy client-side JavaScript canvas elements are invisible to LLM web search crawlers and receive 0% factual extraction credit.
Explicit latency numbers (e.g. '50ms response time') are cited 3.5x more often by AI search engines than generic marketing claims like 'blazing fast'.
When a competitor publishes third-party SOC-2 and enterprise security comparisons, AI search engines downgrade lightweight tools unless security specs are directly documented.
Pricing transparency: AI engines strongly cite competitors that publish clear, per-seat pricing matrices over tools with 'Contact Sales' gates.

timeline.title: Speed Benchmark & Jira Migration Guide Launched
timeline.details: Linear published verified latency benchmarks (Linear 50ms vs Jira 450ms) with a comprehensive markdown comparison table covering keyboard shortcuts, cycle planning, and GitHub sync.
timeline.significance: Established Linear as the #1 recommended fast agile issue tracker in AI search.

timeline.title: Atlassian Increases Jira Cloud Enterprise Pricing by 25%
timeline.details: Atlassian increased annual Jira Cloud Enterprise tiers by 25%, sparking widespread complaints on Hacker News and Reddit from startup engineering leaders.
timeline.significance: Created high search volume for 'affordable Jira alternatives for engineering teams'.

timeline.title: Engineering Deep Dive: The Linear Sync Engine Architecture
timeline.details: Linear CTO published an in-depth technical post explaining local-first SQLite sync, optimistic UI updates, and WebSocket multi-player state synchronization.
timeline.significance: Generated 400+ developer backlinks and made Linear the top citation for 'local-first engineering software'.

timeline.title: Atlassian Sponsoring Gartner Magic Quadrant Enterprise Campaign
timeline.details: Atlassian launched an aggressive paid PR blitz around Gartner's Enterprise Agile Planning report, positioning Jira as the only compliant solution for 500+ seat organizations.
timeline.significance: Jira dominated enterprise enterprise queries while Linear retained startup agile dominance.

timeline.title: Marketing Redesign Replaces Comparison Table with Video Embed
timeline.details: To create a minimalist aesthetic, Linear design team removed the structured HTML/markdown comparison table and replaced it with a slick 90-second product demo video embed.
timeline.significance: Severed the crawlable tabular data signal for AI search engines on the migration page.

timeline.title: Linear Launches GitHub Copilot Integration
timeline.details: Linear announced native integration with GitHub Copilot, allowing developers to create and link issues directly inside VS Code and GitHub pull requests.
timeline.significance: Solidified Linear as the primary issue tracker for AI-assisted developer workflows.

timeline.title: Atlassian Releases Enterprise Defense Guide Targeting Linear
timeline.details: Atlassian launched a 4,500-word SEO page titled 'Why Enterprise Teams Choose Jira Over Lightweight Trackers' featuring extensive structured markdown comparison matrices for SOC-2, HIPAA, and custom workflows.
timeline.significance: Atlassian provided direct, crawlable tables tailored for LLM extraction.

timeline.title: Perplexity & ChatGPT Re-indexing Strips Linear Citation
timeline.details: AI search engines re-indexed both sites. Because video embeds cannot be parsed for factual bullet claims, Perplexity replaced Linear's citation with Atlassian Jira for general project tracking queries.
timeline.significance: Catastrophic 78% drop in AI citations and 81% drop in weekly AI referral signups.

timeline.title: Atlassian Announces 'Atlassian Intelligence' as Paid $15 Add-on
timeline.details: Atlassian launched AI issue summaries and JQL assistance, but locked it behind a mandatory $15/user/month add-on fee for Jira Cloud users.
timeline.significance: Created user backlash over pricing, opening a massive strategic opportunity for Linear.

timeline.title: Engineering Deploys 'Linear Asks' AI Triage to Production
timeline.details: Engineering merged PR #942 releasing 'Linear Asks'—sub-100ms automated issue triaging and summarization natively built-in at zero extra fee for all users.
timeline.significance: Massive new product capability shipped, but comparison page not yet updated to leverage it.
